title: Time Arithmetic
description:
```
Time 1: 10:45:30
Time 2: 03:20:45
Sum:        14:06:15
Difference: 07:24:45
Time 1 + 1000s: 11:02:10
Time 1 is earlier than Time 2? false
In 12h format: 10:45:30 AM
```
requirements: `struct Time { int h{}; int m{}; int s{}; };`
Overloads: `Time add(const Time&, const Time&)` and `Time add(const Time&, int seconds)`
